Recovered the full algorithm from the retained .s plus a resolved literal pool (assembled with arm-none-eabi-as/objdump to decode every pc-relative constant): a 96-byte scratch accumulator (hp/pp/attack/defense/agility/luck/class/four growth pairs) built from an OwnerCombatState-shaped owner blob, an HP/PP growth-rate drift guard, a 27-case per-equipped-item effect-kind switch (additive), a djinn stat-bonus bit-scan loop over 4x20 bits, a class-percentage scaling pass via a class table pointer, a second 8-case per-equipped-item effect-kind switch (multiplicative, kind-7 indexed), class_pct_attack/defense/agility Q3 rounding, two curve-based growth adjustments (quadratic from a luck curve table, linear from an agility curve table), a class_id-driven GameFlag_Test bonus, full clamp block, and the closing HP/PP pool finalize with a 1999/9999 cap chosen by an equip_active flag. Candidate size is byte-exact (2024=2024) and overall control-flow shape matches, but many individual instructions differ purely in which physical register holds a given temporary (r0 vs r1 vs r4/r5 etc. cascading from the first local constant load), which the tool classifies as structural-topology/wrong_instructions rather than a pure allocator-order residual.
